findings.title: httpx.TimeoutException and httpx.ConnectError bypass retry logic in _attempt_gemini and _attempt_xkiro — not fixed since prior review
findings.description: _attempt_gemini and _attempt_xkiro call httpx.AsyncClient.post() with no surrounding try/except for transport exceptions. httpx.TimeoutException and httpx.ConnectError raised during those calls propagate to generate_response's bare 'except Exception' handler, which executes 'break', immediately abandoning the retry loop for that model. No retry with backoff is attempted. Grep for TimeoutException, ConnectError, and httpx.Timeout in ai_provider_service.py returns zero matches, confirming the fix was not applied.
findings.consequence: A single Gemini or xKiro network timeout consumes zero retry budget and immediately triggers failover to the next model, violating AC #17 and original task section 5 which require timeouts to be retried with bounded exponential backoff.
findings.correction: In _attempt_gemini and _attempt_xkiro, wrap the client.post() call: catch (httpx.TimeoutException, httpx.ConnectError) and re-raise as _RetriableFailure. Update test 18 (test_timeout_handled) to assert mock_tracker.record_retry.call_count >= 1 to prevent silent regression.
